body.text: The party we sent out has come back to {param:town}: {param:souls} of them, after {param:months} months on the road.
They found no place they could hold. They are thinner than they left, and they are sleeping in the barns until we find them room.
I do not know yet whether to send them out again or keep them. I should be glad of your view.

options.text: and have read it with care
and would rather not have needed it

options.label: send them out again
options.text: Send them out again, and better found. The land is still there.

options.label: keep the people at home
options.text: Keep the people at home and make the town worth staying in.
